Two separately implemented 64-vertex exhaustive searches agree with all coefficients; the exact local multiplicity claims and all small boundary templates were re-executed. Larger supports inherit the four-point obstruction.

originality.rationale: Prior Hamming closed-neighborhood theorem determines only m=0; the Shrikhande-versus-rook closed-neighborhood census determines only d=2. Neither implies an all-Doob coefficient law 27 binomial(d+1,3)-8m, which separates every graph in each fixed-diameter family. Krotov develops perfect codes, Adler et al. investigate open Hamming neighborhoods, and Coudert et al. give generic computational algorithms, not this all-factor face polynomial.
